notes.title: Update #1 Version S.1.3
notes.notes:
[h1] Update #1 Version S.1.3 [/h1] 

Hey folks! 

We're back with another update. With update S.1.3 we've fixed a large amount of issues that users reported, as well as adding completely new features. 


[h1] What’s Changed in the build since last Build?[/h1] 

• Removed RPG Script in the game that had crashed the game when buying Items.
• Removed Music Player script as no longer needed.
• Fixed opening gate in first town.
• Updated Animals in towns
• Map Fixes
• Removed Online Plugin that caused issues when buying items.



[h1] Added Features[/h1] 

• When you enter a Town/house this will display the name.
• Added full screen support at the crystals if you wish to play the game in full screen.
• Added new Menu System.
• View Controls Item.
• Added full screen item.



Thanks for the continued support. The developer is working hard to make changes to Final Quest with feedback from the Steam community. 

You rock! 
Jonny
